findings.description: The cycle guard was removed from the walk over the exception __cause__ chain, so a cyclic chain now loops forever.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the retried function raises an exception whose __cause__ chain cycles, for example exc1.__cause__ = exc2 and exc2.__cause__ = exc1, or a self-referencing exc.__cause__ = exc. Python permits such assignments. Mechanism: the while condition only checks for None, so exc never becomes None and the loop never exits. Impact: the retry decision hangs the calling thread indefinitely instead of returning, which the removed seen-set was there to prevent.
